title: Multi-AZ High Availability with NAT
prompt: Design a highly available architecture with NAT Gateways in each AZ. Show how private subnet instances in each AZ use their local NAT Gateway, eliminating cross-AZ dependencies and single points of failure.
hints: Deploy one NAT Gateway per AZ in the public subnet
Route each private subnet to its local AZ NAT Gateway
Show that if one AZ fails, the other AZ continues to function independently
Include the Internet Gateway that all NAT Gateways route through
